When Postman Spider takes a tumble, Buzzbee helps out with the deliveries and is delighted to receive lots of letters thanking him for his hard work. After all, one good turn deserves another.
It's the school's birthday and the Queen is coming to visit, but Buzzbee hasn't been picked for any of the important jobs. However his luck soon changes after a chance encounter in the playground.
Buzzbee and Rubee are in competition to provide the most welcoming bedroom for the newest member of the family - Babee.
Buzzbee learns how to do a new magic trick, but when Rubee disappears, he starts to wonder if the magic has gone one step too far.
Buzzbee and Barnabee are camping in the meadow when they get scared by a mysterious noise. However, on further investigation the boys eventually discover it was only Pappa Bee snoring - phew.
When Dr Beetle comes to Honeydew School to give a lesson in First Aid, Buzzbee and friends have to learn quickly when an emergency at Anthill Stores requires their assistance.
Buzzbee tries to help Mamma Bee with her shopping by emailing through her order. However, he doesn't really know how to use a computer and ends up ordering 4 million eggs instead of 4.
It's the egg and spoon race at school but Buzzbee can't stop sneezing, and keeps dropping the egg. Barnabee takes over from Buzzbee and manages to win the race.
It's Pappa Bee's birthday and Buzzbee decides to bake him a special cake - what he doesn't realise is that Rubee's had exactly the same idea.
Jasper teases Buzzbee for still having a Teddy Bee that he sleeps with every night. But then Rubee discovers Jasper has a blankie too.
Katypillar gives Buzzbee some seeds and he's very impatient to see them grow. Nothing seems to work - except time.
Buzzbee learns to always listen carefully before jumping to conclusions.
